## Declarations and implementations

```plato

// Complete sampling state for reading a texture: per-axis wrap modes, the
// filter, the maximum anisotropy ratio (1 disables), a mip level-of-detail
// bias, and the border color used by ClampToBorder.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anisotropic_filtering)
type TextureSampler
    implements IValue
{
    WrapU: WrapMode;
    WrapV: WrapMode;
    WrapW: WrapMode;
    Filter: FilterMode;
    Anisotropy: Number;
    MipBias: Number;
    BorderColor: Color;
}

//==
// ## UV addressing and bindings

// An affine transform applied to UV coordinates before sampling, composed as
// Tiling (scale) first, then Rotation, then Offset.
type UvTransform
    implements IValue
{
    Offset: Vector2D;
    Rotation: Angle;
    Tiling: Number2;
}

// How texture coordinates are generated for a surface; Uv means authored
// coordinates. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UV_mapping)
type TextureProjection
    = Uv | Planar | Triplanar | Spherical | Cylindrical | Box | ScreenSpace;

// Which channels of a sampled texel a consumer reads.
type TextureChannelMask = R | G | B | A | RG | RGB | RGBA;

// A texture wired for use: the descriptor, its sampling state, a UV
// transform, which UV set of the mesh to use (zero-based), and which channels
// to read. The unit of texturing that materials and shaders reference.
type TextureBinding
    implements IValue
{
    Texture: Texture2D;
    Sampler: TextureSampler;
    Transform: UvTransform;
    UvSet: Integer;
    Channels: TextureChannelMask;
}
```
